Copy prompt
I run [name of your platform or app], which is [one-line description]. Review its current features, then propose a new section for [new feature area], sketch two or three mockup iterations, and generate working starter code for the best one. Finish with a short summary of what you built and what I should review; don't deploy or publish anything without showing me first.
